experiment: P3o-A low-power attribution: coverage, joint checkpoint, and CP-safe calibration
purpose: Separate training-identity coverage, parameter-first checkpoint conflict, and finite-sample safety calibration before introducing a new physical representation.

identity_amendment.reason: 780000000 was consumed by P5b1 and 840000000/850000000 by P5b2/P5b3 before P3o-A generation. This amendment is made before P3o-A data generation or development access.

training.parameter_loss: 0.1 * masked SmoothL1 over label=1 AND parameter_mask=1 AND finite(target)

checkpoint_rules.C_joint: among epochs with early oracle parameter macro-NMAE <= 1.01 * C_param value, maximum early macro-AUPR

threshold_rules.T_F1: per-class F1 grid on calibration identities only
threshold_rules.T_safe: replace only ISRJ threshold by the lowest calibration score threshold for which every regime x power negative cell has one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson FPR upper bound <= 0.10
threshold_rules.infeasible_rule: report infeasible; do not relax cap or substitute empirical FPR

formal_matrix.additional_budget_control: small_step_matched evaluated with the same checkpoint and threshold matrix

post_development_rule: No model, loss, data-role, training-budget, checkpoint, threshold, CP-cap or gate change after seed860000000 development predictions are opened. If a gate fails, freeze P3o-A and enter P3o-B only if the attribution rule identifies representation insufficiency.
